analyst_view.overall: Early view: Mallorca (6th, 15 scored, 7 conceded) under Luis García are hard to beat at Son Moix, with Adrián Fuentes scoring seven of their 15 goals. Burgos (3rd) under Sergio Francisco have the best home record in the division but have taken far fewer points away. Mallorca's league game at Andorra was postponed and still needs a date, which could crowd their December.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.8 goals. Mallorca concede very little and Burgos are much less dangerous away than at El Plantío, so a low total fits and I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. Mallorca attack down the flanks with crosses from Álex Sala and Zito Luvumbo and kept up pressure on Cádiz until late, so I lean slightly higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards. Sergi Darder was close to a red against Cádiz, but nothing else points either way and the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.2 shots. Mallorca should have most of the ball and Burgos will look to stay compact away, which fits the figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.5 shots on target. Nothing in the news points either way, so I stay with the number.
